column1: # Plugin version mapping (single source of truth for the rundeck-plugins version-bump skill)
#   plugin_repo     = repo name under github.com/rundeck-plugins (also the gh release source)
#   core_prop       = property name in rundeck/gradle.properties (<prop>=<ver>), or - if Core does not bundle it
#   rundeckpro_prop = property name in rundeckpro/gradle.properties, or - if not consumed
#   ua_runner_prop  = property name in ua-runner/gradle.properties, or - if not consumed
#   - Core (rundeck) reads these *PluginVersion props from gradle.properties; build.gradle interpolates
#     them into bundledPlugins and testbuild.groovy reads them. build.yaml no longer carries versions.
#   - kubernetes uses kubernetesVersion in rundeckpro but kubernetesPluginVersion in ua-runner.
#   - nixy-step-plugins publishes one release that drives nixystepVersion (4 artifacts share it).
#   - VIA-SUBMODULE means ua-runner has no property of its own to bump for this plugin:
#     runner-agent/build.gradle's bundledCorePlugins map reads the version straight out of the
#     nested rundeck/ git submodule's gradle.properties at build time, via its own separate
#     Properties object - it never reads ua-runner's own gradle.properties for these. A same-named
#     property was added to ua-runner's gradle.properties on 2026-09-17 on the theory that an
#     explicit property beats an implicit submodule read; that property turned out to be dead
#     (verified by reading bundledCorePlugins itself, 2026-09-17), so it was removed and this
#     reverted to VIA-SUBMODULE. The real version in effect is whatever commit ua-runner's
#     rundeck/ submodule is pinned to - neither check-versions.sh nor bump-versions-pr.sh
#     currently inspects that pinned commit, so drift here isn't yet caught by this skill.
